title: Deliver Oil to Fludingstone Bay Oil Refinery
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Oil** delivered to **Fludingstone Bay Oil Refinery** (industry id 4, near tile 226,56).

A likely supplier is **Danfield Oil Wells** (industry id 64, near tile 202,55); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **570 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.
